answer: Make the proof a habit the applicant already has. Proof of apprenticeship completion via trade guild journeyman record is a habit with a paper trail: a record the guild has kept since the apprentice finished. The grove of the habit is repetition - the same small act, year after year, done for its own sake. A farm must invent a decade of habits, and the river of the invention is the calendar: every date in sequence, every amount consistent, no gaps. The umber that exposes a fresh forgery is the dust on the file - a record made last week has none.
